prompt: You installed the software on the first host of a new deployment. Which command creates the cluster on that node from the CLI?
explanation: `rladmin cluster create` bootstraps the cluster on the node where it runs, taking a cluster name plus the admin username and password. `cluster join` attaches a node to an existing cluster, the install script only lays down the software, and `cluster recover` restores a cluster from a backup file — none of them create a new cluster.

options.text: rladmin cluster create name cluster.local username admin@example.com password admin-password
rladmin cluster join nodes 10.0.0.1 username admin@example.com password admin-password
